LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Notes from a Crazed Researcher
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Notes from a Crazed Researcher (T-09-78) is an equippable HE Tool Abnormality.\nIts mad insights boost work, research, and abnormality study speed by +50% and study success rate by +10%, but reaching 60 cumulative HP/SP damage (Black hits count double) or returning it before 30s and 1 non-tool study triggers a lethal RED gore explosion.
